_comment: PEB Gateway egg (ptero-enhanced-backup). Image is built locally: docker build -t peb-gateway:dev gateway/
name: PEB Gateway
author: 46058672+FischLord@users.noreply.github.com
description: S3-compatible gateway that stores Pterodactyl backups deduplicated in a restic repository.

variables.name: S3 Access Key
variables.description: S3 access key the panel and Wings use (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID).

variables.name: S3 Secret Key
variables.description: S3 secret key (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY).

variables.name: Bucket
variables.description: Bucket name, must match AWS_BACKUPS_BUCKET in the panel.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Must match AWS_DEFAULT_REGION in the panel.

variables.name: Restic Password
variables.description: Key to all backups. Losing it loses all data.

variables.name: Restic Repository
variables.description: Optional. Restic repository path or URL. Empty = <data>/repo. Example: /mnt/peb/repo (Pterodactyl mount).

variables.name: Listen Address
variables.description: Optional. Empty = 0.0.0.0:SERVER_PORT (allocation port).

variables.name: Max Part Bytes
variables.description: Largest accepted part size in bytes.

variables.name: Max Spool Bytes
variables.description: Spool quota in bytes.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Bearer token for the admin API (/admin/v1), at least 32 characters. Empty = admin API disabled.

variables.name: Metrics Token
variables.description: Optional own bearer token for GET /metrics (Prometheus), at least 32 characters. Empty = the admin token is used; without either token /metrics is off.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Local time zone for the maintenance window.

variables.name: Maintenance Time
variables.description: Daily maintenance window (HH:MM, local time): unlock, prune, check, stats.

variables.name: Prune Enabled
variables.description: Run restic prune in the daily window (true/false).

variables.name: Check Interval
variables.description: How often restic check runs, Go duration (168h = weekly, 0 = never).

variables.name: Check Read Data Subset
variables.description: Optional. Extra data to read during restic check, e.g. 5%. Empty = metadata only.

variables.name: Repository Capacity
variables.description: Optional. Capacity of the repository target in bytes, for the 'full in N days' forecast.

variables.name: ntfy Topic URL
variables.description: Optional. Full ntfy topic URL for failure notifications.

variables.name: ntfy Token
variables.description: Optional. ntfy access token.

variables.name: Maintenance Timeout
variables.description: Deadline for each maintenance job (Go duration). restic is killed after it.

variables.name: Maintenance Busy Wait
variables.description: How long maintenance waits for running backups/restores before skipping (Go duration).

variables.name: Download Timeout
variables.description: Deadline for one restore/download (Go duration).

variables.name: Offsite Repository
variables.description: Optional. Second restic repository for the offsite copy, e.g. rclone:gdrive:peb (Google Drive via rclone), sftp:user@host:/path or s3:... Empty = no offsite copy. Must differ from the main repository.

variables.name: Offsite Password
variables.description: Optional. Password of the offsite repository. Empty = same password as the main repository.

variables.name: Offsite Delay
variables.description: Optional. Quiet time after the last backup before the offsite copy starts (Go duration).

variables.name: Prune Skip Warning
variables.description: Warn (notification, status warning) after this many scheduled prune jobs in a row were skipped because the repository was busy. 0 = never.

variables.name: Trash Retention
variables.description: How long a backup deleted in the panel stays recoverable in the gateway trash before the nightly maintenance removes it (Go duration, 0 = forget immediately).

variables.name: Deleted Server Retention
variables.description: How long the backups of a server deleted in the panel are kept before they are removed (Go duration, 0 = at the next maintenance window).

variables.name: Trash Warning Size (GB)
variables.description: Send a notification 24 hours before the trash is emptied if at least this many GB of original backup data are affected. 0 = never.

variables.name: Offsite Forget Grace
variables.description: Optional. A snapshot must be missing in the main repository this long before its offsite copy is forgotten (Go duration, 0 = no grace).

variables.name: Offsite Forget Release
variables.description: Optional, normally empty. Releases a stopped offsite forget step (more than 10% / 20 snapshots, or a changed repository ID): set it to the repository ID of the offsite repository shown in the notification, then remove it again.

variables.name: rclone Config
variables.description: Optional. Path of the rclone config file for rclone: repositories, e.g. /home/container/rclone.conf (the file lives in the server volume).
